translationRepairs: Sixth month, jiyou: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.
Sixth month, guiyou: five-colored clouds appeared by the sun.
癸酉 is guiyou, not jiyou.
On dingchou, seven princes of the blood were made dukes.
On dingchou, the heirs of seven imperial-clan princes (Qin, Lu, Cai, Wei, Yan, Chen and Yue) were enfeoffed as dukes.
七王后 means the descendants of the seven princes, who were made dukes.
On jiaxu, Hezhou chief Xiqin Ding Muzheng received golden purple-girdle grand mentor rank and acting justice minister.
On jiaxu, Xiqin Ding Muzheng, Prefect of Hezhou, was made Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and acting Minister of Justice.
河州刺史 is the Prefect of Hezhou; 金紫光祿大夫 is Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
Han Lin and other transport commissioners were rewarded for raising revenue without ruin.
Han Shu, Transport Commissioner of Zizhou Circuit, and others were rewarded with silk by degree for promoting benefits and removing harms.
韓璹 is read Han Shu, not "Han Lin"; the unit names Zizhou Circuit.
On guiyou, Sima Guang became acting western capital regent.
On guiyou, Sima Guang became acting administrator of the Western Capital Branch Censorate.
權判西京留台 is an acting post at the Branch Censorate in Luoyang, not a regency.
Zhong E was further demoted to Hezhou registrar.
Zhong E was further demoted to Administrative Aide of Hezhou.
別駕 is an administrative aide, not a registrar; 賀州 is Hezhou.
On gengshen, the cabinet’s third honorific title was refused.
On gengshen, the assembled officials for the third time offered the honorific title Emperor Who Continues Heaven, Models Antiquity, Cultured, Martial, Humane and Filial; it was refused.
群臣 is all the officials, not the cabinet; the title is named in the text.
Ninth month, bingxu: the Yellow River burst at Yanzhou.
Ninth month, bingxu: the Yellow River burst its banks at Yunzhou.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.
On jiazi, Duke Shi Qing of Yue became Prince of Kuaiji.
On jiazi, Shiqing, Duke of Yue, was made Prince of Kuaiji Commandery.
世清 is a single given name (Shiqing); the title is Duke of Yue.
Sixth month, renzi: Zeng Gongliang retired as grand mentor.
Sixth month, renzi: Zeng Gongliang retired as Grand Preceptor.
The text reads 以太傅致仕 (以 garbled as 乙); 太傅 is Grand Preceptor.
Fifth month, guimao new moon: Yang Guixian of Bozhou sent his son Guangzhen, who received a court rank.
Fifth month, guimao new moon: Yang Guiqian of Bozhou sent his son Guangzhen with tribute; Guangzhen was made Three-Rank Attendant.
楊貴遷 is Yang Guiqian (遷 qian), not "Guixian".
Year seven, first month, xinhai: Min and Tao victors were rewarded; Sang Chen and others were promoted.
Year seven, first month, xinhai: those who recovered Minzhou and Taozhou were rewarded; Sang Shi, Commissioner of the Western Capital Left Storehouse, and others were promoted by degree.
桑湜 is Sang Shi (湜 shi), not "Sang Chen".
On yimao, Prince Jun became Duke of Yong.
On yimao, the imperial son Jun was made Duke of Yong.
皇子俊 is an imperial son, given a ducal title, not a prince.
Year six, first month, xinhai: Xi was restored as temple founder, paired with the Felt-Life Lord.
Year six, first month, xinhai: Xizu was restored as the founding ancestor of the Imperial Ancestral Temple and paired with the Lord of Inspired Birth.
僖祖 is the temple name Xizu.
On yiwei, Jing Sili died fighting Guizhang at Tabai stockade.
On yiwei, Jing Sili, Prefect of Hezhou, and others fought Qingyijie Guizhang at Tabai City and were defeated and killed.
知河州 is the prefect of Hezhou; 踏白城 is Tabai City, not a stockade.
Year eight, first month, gengzi: Cai Ting and Feng Jing left their posts.
Year eight, first month, gengzi: Cai Ting was dismissed as Administrator of the Southern Capital Branch Censorate, and Feng Jing was dismissed and made Prefect of Bozhou.
The text names the posts: 判南京留司御史台 and 知亳州.
Han Jiang joined the council and Lü Huiqing became vice premier.
Han Jiang was made Joint Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery and Director of the State History Compilation, and Hanlin Academician Lü Huiqing became Assisting Civil Councillor.
參知政事 is Assisting Civil Councillor, not vice premier; the unit names both posts.

On renzi, Zhu Tang of Yizhou accused the former Yuyao county registrar Li Feng of plotting rebellion, and his testimony implicated the Right Feathered Forest Great General Shiju and the Hezhong observation aide Xu Ge; Censor-in-Chief Deng Chuo, Remonstrance Bureau director Fan Bailu, and censor Xu Xi were ordered to investigate the case jointly.

On renzi, Zhu Tang, a commoner of Yizhou, accused Li Feng, former registrar of Yuyao County, of plotting rebellion; his testimony implicated the Right Feathered Forest Great General Shiju and Xu Ge, observation aide of Hezhong Prefecture. Vice Censor-in-Chief Deng Wan, Remonstrance Bureau administrator Fan Bailu and Censor Xu Xi were ordered to try the case jointly.
鄧綰 is Deng Wan (綰 wan), not "Deng Chuo"; 御史中丞 is the Vice Censor-in-Chief.
On xinhai, Zhao Xi led the An Nam campaign with Li Xian as deputy against Jiaozhi.

On xinhai, Zhao Xie, Academician-in-Waiting of the Tianzhang Pavilion, became Pacification and Punitive Commissioner of the Annan Circuit, with Li Xian, Defense Commissioner of Jiazhou, as his deputy, to attack Jiaozhi.
趙禼 is Zhao Xie (禼 xie), not "Zhao Xi".
Second month, wuzi: Guo Kui replaced Li Xian; Zhao Xi became his deputy on the An Nam front.

Second month, wuzi: Guo Kui, Commissioner of the Southern Court of Palace Affairs, became Pacification and Punitive Commissioner of the Annan Circuit; Li Xian was dismissed and Zhao Xie made his deputy.
趙禼 is Zhao Xie, not "Zhao Xi".
On guichou, Shen Kuo returned from Liao.
On guichou, Drafter of Edicts Shen Kuo was sent as the return envoy to Liao.
報聘 means going on a return embassy, not returning from Liao.
Tenth month, gengyin: Lü Huiqing left Chenzhou prefecture.
Tenth month, gengyin: Lü Huiqing was dismissed and made Prefect of Chenzhou.
罷知陳州 means he left the council to become prefect of Chenzhou.
On xinsi, Su Jian was ennobled Loyal and Brave posthumously; his son Ziyuan entered palace service.

On xinsi, Su Jian was posthumously named Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army with the posthumous name Zhongyong (Loyal and Brave); his son Ziyuan was made Western Head Palace Attendant and Audience Usher.
The text gives a posthumous office and name, not ennoblement.
On bingwu, Wang Keichen led the Liao condolence mission.
On bingwu, Wang Kechen and others were sent to Liao to offer condolences.
On jichou, Wang Qing, Cui Zhaoyong, Liu Gui, and Zhang Yiyuan fell at Maozhou.
On jichou, Wang Qing, Area Supervisor of Mianzhou, Cui Zhaoyong, Liu Gui and Left Palace Guard Zhang Yi went to the relief of Maozhou and died fighting.
張乂 is Zhang Yi; 援 means went to the relief and is not part of the name.
On jichou, Cheng Shiming led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.
On jichou, Cheng Shimeng and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler on his birthday and the New Year.
程師孟 is Cheng Shimeng, not "Shiming".
On gengyin, Prince Zi Yong was born.
On gengyin, an imperial son, Yong, was born.
子傭生 means a son named Yong was born; "Zi" is not part of his name and he was not yet a prince.
On guimao, Guo Kui crushed Jiaozhi at the Fu River, took Hong Zhen, and withdrew after Li Qianfu’s surrender.
On guimao, Guo Kui defeated Jiaozhi at the Fuliang River and captured its false crown prince Hong Zhen; Li Qiande sent men with a memorial of surrender to the army gate, and Kui then withdrew.
李乾德 is Li Qiande, not "Li Qianfu"; 富良江 is the Fuliang River.
On yimao, Liao mourning canceled the Shared Heaven birthday rites.
On yiwei, the Tongtian Festival birthday toasts were cancelled because of the death of the Liao ruler's mother.
乙未 is yiwei, not yimao.
Guangyuan became Shun prefecture; Li Qianfu was forgiven.
Guangyuan Prefecture became Shunzhou, and Li Qiande was pardoned.
李乾德 is Li Qiande, not "Li Qianfu".
Guo Kui took Tanzhou; Zhao Xi took Guizhou.
Guo Kui was made Administrator of Tanzhou and Zhao Xie Prefect of Guizhou.
趙禼 is Zhao Xie, not "Zhao Xi".
On dinghai, Zi Yong became prince of Jun.
On dinghai, the imperial son Yong was made Duke of Jun.
封子傭爲均國公 makes the son Yong a duke (國公), not a prince; "Zi" is not part of his name.
On jiaxu, Zong Pu became prince of Puyang and joined the council.
On jiaxu, Zongpu was made concurrently Palace Attendant and enfeoffed as Prince of Puyang Commandery.
兼侍中 is an honorary concurrent post; he did not join the council.
On guisi, Zong Yi became prince of Pu.
On guisi, Zongyi, Military Commissioner of Zhaohua Army, was enfeoffed as Duke of Pu.
濮國公 is Duke of Pu, not prince.
Second month, gengxu: Prince of Pu Zong Yi died.
Second month, gengxu: Zongyi, Duke of Pu, died.
濮國公 is Duke of Pu, not prince.
On jiayin, Zong Hui became prince of Pu and Huaiang commissioner.
On jiayin, Zonghui, Surveillance Commissioner of Yongzhou, became Military Commissioner of Huaikang Army and was enfeoffed as Duke of Pu.
濮國公 is Duke of Pu; 淮康軍 is Huaikang Army.
Eighth month, guimao: Nai’erwen and Luzun were executed for treason.
Eighth month, guimao: the western frontier officers Ne'erwen and Luzun plotted rebellion and were executed.
On guimao, Li Qianfu’s plea to recover Guangyuan was denied.
On guiwei, Li Qiande petitioned for the return of Guangyuan and other prefectures; the request was refused.
李乾德 is Li Qiande, not "Li Qianfu"; 癸未 is guiwei.
On bingchen, Wang Yun was spared for patricide revenge but banished and tattooed.
On bingchen, Wang Yun, a commoner of Qingzhou, was spared death for avenging his father, but was tattooed and exiled to a neighboring prefecture.
復父仇 means avenging his father, not patricide.
On dingsi, Chief Councilor Chen Shengshi retired as Duke of Xiu and Zhenjiang commissioner.
On dingsi, Chen Shengzhi retired as Acting Defender-in-Chief, retaining his rank as Joint Manager of Affairs, Military Commissioner of Zhenjiang Army, Supreme Pillar of State and Duke of Xiu.
陳升之 is Chen Shengzhi, not "Shengshi".
陳升之 is Chen Shengzhi, not "Shengshi".
On gengchen, Prince Pu’an Yi’s three consorts were enshrined at Pu Garden as princesses.
On gengchen, the three wives of Prince Anyi of Pu were all titled Princess Consort and buried with him in the Pu Garden.
濮安懿王 is Prince Anyi of Pu; 祔 means joint burial with him.
On wuzi, Cai Que joined the participating council.
On wuzi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Cai Que became Assisting Civil Councillor.
參知政事 is Assisting Civil Councillor.
On jichou, Zhu of Handsome Favor was promoted to Bright Countenance.
On jichou, Lady Zhu, Handsome Fairness, was promoted to Lady of Bright Countenance.
婕妤 is Handsome Fairness and 昭容 Lady of Bright Countenance; 朱氏 is Lady Zhu.
Ninth month, guimao: Shunchang prisoners were commuted and lesser offenders freed.
Ninth month, guiwei: Shunchang Army prisoners had their sentences reduced one degree and those with penal servitude or less were freed.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.
Eleventh month, guimao: he reopened court at Promoting Governance Hall.
Eleventh month, guiwei: he began holding court in the Chongzheng Hall.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.
